messages.subject: issue with shinyapps.io iframe and window.location.hash
parts: I have an app that gets and tracks state using window.location.hash.  When deploying to shinyapps.io it gets put inside an iframe and this functionality goes away.  Is there a way to work around this?

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] issue with shinyapps.io iframe and window.location.hash

You could trying using window.top.location which points to the parent frame.

-Andy
